name: Gasthof Mühle
beschreibung:
Perched high above the Inn Valley on sunny Wattenberg, Gasthof Muehle is a peaceful sanctuary for hikers and nature lovers. Cosy rooms and dishes made with local farm produce create genuine comfort.

Hiking paths across the Tux Alps and the Swarovski Crystal Worlds in Wattens are just a short trip away.
kurzbeschreibung: Mountain inn Gasthof Muehle on Wattenberg offers alpine peace and sweeping views in the Hall-Wattens region.
